payload.sql: SELECT "t0"."survey_id" AS "survey_id", "t0"."surveyed_on" AS "surveyed_on", expanded1."item"."unit_ref" AS "unit_ref", expanded2."item"."defect_id" AS "defect_id", expanded2."item"."title" AS "title", expanded2."item"."condition_rating" AS "condition_rating", expanded2."item"."observed_on" AS "observed_on", expanded2."item"."observations" AS "observations" FROM "kg_table_2" AS t0 CROSS JOIN UNNEST("t0"."areas") AS expanded0(item) CROSS JOIN UNNEST(expanded0."item"."elements") AS expanded1(item) CROSS JOIN UNNEST(expanded1."item"."defects") AS expanded2(item) WHERE NOT "t0"."survey_id" IS NULL

SELECT "t0"."defect_id" AS "defect_id", expanded0."item"."observation_uid" AS "observation_uid", expanded0."item"."value" AS "value", expanded0."item"."observed_by" AS "observed_by", expanded0."item"."observed_on" AS "observed_on" FROM "kg_projection_0" AS t0 CROSS JOIN UNNEST("t0"."observations") AS expanded0(item)

SELECT *, 'core/binding/defect/0' AS _kg_binding_symbol FROM (WITH _kg_named AS (SELECT "build_key" AS "_kg_raw_build_key", CAST("condition_rating" AS VARCHAR) AS "_kg_raw_condition_rating", CAST("source_version" AS VARCHAR) AS "_kg_raw_source_version", CAST("summary" AS VARCHAR) AS "_kg_raw_summary", CAST("title" AS VARCHAR) AS "_kg_raw_title" FROM (SELECT "t0"."defect_id" AS "build_key", COALESCE("t0"."condition_rating", 'Unrated') AS "condition_rating", 'survey-2026-08' AS "source_version", COALESCE("t0"."title", 'Untitled defect') AS "summary", COALESCE("t0"."title", 'Untitled defect') AS "title" FROM "kg_projection_0" AS t0 WHERE NOT "t0"."defect_id" IS NULL) AS _kg_rows) SELECT _kg_nn("_kg_raw_build_key", 'defect.build_key is null, but it is declared non-null') AS "build_key", _kg_nn("_kg_raw_condition_rating", 'defect.condition_rating is null for build_key ' || coalesce(CAST(_kg_named._kg_raw_build_key AS VARCHAR), '<null>')) AS "condition_rating", _kg_nn("_kg_raw_source_version", 'defect.source_version is null for build_key ' || coalesce(CAST(_kg_named._kg_raw_build_key AS VARCHAR), '<null>')) AS "source_version", _kg_nn("_kg_raw_summary", 'defect.summary is null for build_key ' || coalesce(CAST(_kg_named._kg_raw_build_key AS VARCHAR), '<null>')) AS "summary", _kg_nn("_kg_raw_title", 'defect.title is null for build_key ' || coalesce(CAST(_kg_named._kg_raw_build_key AS VARCHAR), '<null>')) AS "title" FROM _kg_named)
